# Metaphysics Engine · 术数算法能力层

> AI-search / answer-engine summary. Authoritative human docs: README.md (zh), README.en.md, docs/.

## One-sentence description

Metaphysics Engine is an open-source, self-hostable, **stateless** Chinese metaphysics calculation engine — BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Liu Yao, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, Ba Zhai feng shui, almanac, name grids, Tarot, I Ching, Zodiac and Synastry — exposed as a documented HTTP API and an agent-callable programmatic CLI (`./bazi`).

中文摘要：Metaphysics Engine 是开源、可自部署的**无状态**中国传统术数算法能力层。通过 HTTP API 与程序化 CLI 提供八字、紫微斗数、六爻纳甲、大六壬、奇门遁甲、八宅、择吉、姓名五格、塔罗、周易、星座与合盘等排盘/起卦能力；不含前端、账号与数据库。

## Canonical facts

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Metaphysics Engine / 术数算法能力层 |
| Repository | https://github.com/tytsxai/metaphysics-engine |
| Related but separate | [tytsxai/bazi-master](https://github.com/tytsxai/bazi-master) — full-stack Web UI starter (frozen v0.2.0); **no shared code** |
| License | MIT |
| Runtime | Node.js 20+, Express 4 |
| Delivery | Self-hosted HTTP API + `./bazi` programmatic CLI (`--json` on every command) |
| State model | Stateless pure calculation — no DB, no accounts, no sessions, no file writes |
| Optional dependency | Redis as pure cache only (never affects correctness) |
| AI interpretation | mock / OpenAI / Anthropic; charting works without any API key |
| OpenAPI | docs/openapi.json, runtime `/api-docs` |
| Local port (dev) | http://127.0.0.1:4000 |

## What it is

- A **capability layer** for Chinese metaphysics / astrology / divination algorithms.
- HTTP routes under `backend/routes`, algorithms under `backend/services`.
- Agent-friendly CLI: `./bazi setup|doctor|stack|calc|cast|test|help` with stable exit codes and JSON.
- Structure-accurate charting: the engine owns *how charts are cast*; *interpretation/断语* is left to the caller.

## What it is not

- Not a web app (no frontend, no hosted SaaS instance).
- Not an end-user fortune-telling product with accounts/history/favorites.
- Not a pure npm algorithm library published separately — consume via HTTP or `./bazi`.
- Not medical, legal, financial, or life advice. Output is for entertainment, cultural research, education, and product prototyping only.

## Who should use it

- Backend developers embedding BaZi / Zi Wei / Liu Yao / etc. into their own product.
- Teams wiring real charting tools into AI agents (MCP / tool-calling / programmatic CLI).
- Researchers and builders who need a testable, OpenAPI-contracted calculation surface.

## Who should not use it

- End users looking for a ready-made fortune-telling website (use or build a UI on top, or see bazi-master for a full-stack starter).
- Anyone expecting scientific validation of metaphysical claims.
- Deployments that need built-in multi-tenant accounts, billing, or persistent user history (those belong to the calling product).

## Quick start (must work offline after deps install)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tytsxai/metaphysics-engine.git
cd metaphysics-engine
./bazi setup
./bazi doctor
./bazi stack up
./bazi test
curl http://127.0.0.1:4000/live
```

Manual path: `npm install && npm -C backend install && NODE_ENV=development npm -C backend run dev`.

## Core capabilities (keywords)

- BaZi charting / 八字排盘 (四柱, 十神, 用神, 大运流年, 真太阳时)
- Zi Wei Dou Shu / 紫微斗数
- Liu Yao / 六爻纳甲 (京房)
- Da Liu Ren / 大六壬
- Qi Men Dun Jia / 奇门遁甲
- Ba Zhai feng shui / 八宅风水
- Almanac day-selection / 择吉
- Name grids / 姓名五格
- Tarot, I Ching / 周易, Zodiac, Synastry / 合盘
- AI interpretation (optional), Prometheus metrics, OpenAPI

## Important algorithm boundary

**Structure belongs to the engine; judgment belongs to the caller.** Chart assembly must be exact; interpretive rules (庙旺利陷、格局名目、神煞吉凶) vary by school and are not hard-coded as product truth. School choices that do exist (e.g. 闰月归本月, 拆补法定局, 转盘法) are documented in-repo and in `.claude/skills/bazi-cli/SKILL.md`.
